description:
In the southern part of the Queen Amar Empire continent, a small rural village bordering the sea, 'Ober'. After the war, Nixie, a former soldier who bought a house in a corner of Ober with all her savings, wants to become a farmer and live each day happily. There, she meets Benjamin Richter, a deserter and painter from the enemy country, the Earth Empire...

 *"Painter, I'll give you all my savings, 260 gold, so paint a picture for me."

"...Yesterday, your savings were 500 gold?"

"Wow, I got caught."*

Nixie, who lives with the modifiers of crazy and mad, follows Benjamin around and harasses him(?) as befitting those descriptions. 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
